The '''3Z3 medical droid''' was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], that was mainly used by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. At the request of the Imperial bureaucrats, Industrial Automaton installed combat scenario programming, allowing it to be used on battlefields.<ref name="LECG" />

The [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] used these droids extensively. Though operating extremely well on the battlefield, these droids were known to have problems with behavior when used in the private sector. In [[137 ABY]], after the [[Battle of Borosk (137 ABY)|Battle of Borosk]], a 3Z3 droid, [[K2-3Z3]], saw to the medical treatment of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Ran Harkas]] of [[Joker Squad]].<ref name="LECG" />
